stories.title: Luxury bridal room and outdoor wedding service area added to Soughton Hall plans
stories.summary: Plans for a permanent new wedding venue at historic Soughton Hall have been updated to include an outdoor wedding venue space and more luxurious bridal room. stories.summary: Flintshire has half the number of full-size 3G football pitches it needs for its current player base, according to a new plan that identifies three priority sites for new pitches at Deeside Leisure Centre, Hawarden High School and St David’s High School in Saltney. stories.title: Motorcyclist stopped at 96mph on return trip to Wirral from north Wales found with illegal tyre
stories.summary: A motorcyclist travelling at 96mph on a return journey to the Wirral from north Wales has been stopped by North Wales Police roads officers and found to be riding on an illegal rear tyre, with a pillion passenger on board. stories.title: Welsh Ambulance Service stands down critical incident declared during extreme heat
stories.summary: The Welsh Ambulance Service has stood down a critical incident declared three days ago during the recent period of extreme heat, but has warned that demand on 999 remains high. stories.title: Borderlands line passengers could be overpaying at station terminals, Flintshire councillor warns
stories.summary: A motion going before Flintshire County Council this week calls for a public warning over contactless payment terminals at Borderlands line train stations, after warning that some passengers are being charged more than they need to pay.
